# Supported versions

These are the releases of NetBox and PowerDNS that nbpdns supports. The
development lab runs each one, and the integration tests read from every one,
so these are the releases that are tested.

## NetBox

nbpdns reads DNS data from these releases of NetBox and the
[NetBox DNS plugin](https://github.com/peteeckel/netbox-plugin-dns).

| NetBox | NetBox DNS plugin |
|---|---|
| 4.7.x | 1.7.x |

nbpdns checks NetBox and the plugin against this table separately, since
NetBox won't load a plugin release that doesn't support it. Before it reads,
each command checks the releases that NetBox reports:

- If the plugin isn't installed, the command fails.
- If NetBox or the plugin isn't a release in the table, the command logs a
  warning and carries on, since reading may still work.
  `nbpdns netbox check` reports it as a failed check.

nbpdns reads through NetBox's REST API, with an API token. Use a v2 token,
which starts with `nbt_`. A v1 token still works, with a warning.

## PowerDNS

nbpdns reads each server group's primary through the HTTP API of these
releases of the PowerDNS Authoritative Server. The development lab runs each
one as the primary of a server group, and the integration tests read from
every one.

| PowerDNS Authoritative Server |
|---|
| 5.1.x |

Before it reads, each command asks the primary what it is:

- If it isn't an authoritative server, such as a PowerDNS Recursor, the
  command fails.
- If its release isn't in the table, the command logs a warning and carries
  on, since reading may still work. `nbpdns powerdns check` reports it as a
  failed check.

nbpdns reads with the server's API key, sent in the `X-API-Key` header.
